ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can automate assembly, but workers still decide how to adjust the process, coordinate the team, and handle anomalies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 1,467,100 assemblers and fabricators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,465,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,200 jobs, with roughly 156,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $42,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace assembly teams, but it will reduce standardized stations. Automated assembly and robotics speed up routine fitting, shifting assemblers from installing standard parts toward flexible assembly, collaboration, and self-inspection. Pure standardized stations face the greatest pressure, while multiskilled workers who collaborate well are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Flexible assembly: people handle small batches.
Team collaboration: people make crews work.
Exception response: people make the tradeoffs.
Quality self-inspection: people provide tactile judgment.
Multiskill switching: people adapt to change.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in a low-moderate exposure zone. Systems accelerate some steps, while roles remain wherever people must judge outcomes and provide final assurance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Installing standard parts is being automated, not flexible assembly and collaboration. Multiskilled workers who collaborate well become scarcer as productivity improves. Those limited to one standardized station face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This field is contracting, so develop multiple skills and collaboration early. Pure station work is shrinking in the AI era.
Move beyond a single station to multiskill work and collaboration, and learn flexible assembly.
Highlight multiple skills and low defect rates. Factories value steady performance and teamwork.
Do not evaluate workers only by speed. Look for collaboration and multiple skills; strong performers can advance to line leader.

ai_s7_trends: Automated assembly expands while standardized work contracts.
Flexible collaboration creates opportunities.
Multiskilled workers are increasingly sought after.

body: Team Assemblers lead product assembly, coordinating parts, processes, and cycle times. They use tools and teamwork to complete assembly and inspect the finished quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robots can automate assembly, but workers still decide how to adjust the process, coordinate the team, and handle anomalies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能自动装，但怎么调、怎么协、异常怎么处，还是装配工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年团队装配工在岗约 146.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 146.59 万人，岗位净减约 0.12 万个，年均产生约 15.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.22 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代团队装配工，但会压缩标准工位。自动装配与机器人把常规拼装提速，装配工从「装标准件」挪向「柔性装配、协作、质量自检」。真正被挤掉的是纯标准工位，懂多能、能协作的人更稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「装标准件」动作，不是「柔性装配与协作」的岗位。有多能、能协作的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只守一个标准工位。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行在被压缩，早点练多能和协作，AI 时代纯工位在缩。
从「单工位」升级成「多能 + 协作」，学柔性装配。
突出多能与低不良，工厂看重稳和配合。
选人别只看快，看协作和多能，骨干值得给线长。

ai_s7_trends: 自动装配普及，标准缩。
柔性协作带来机会。
多能工更抢手。

body: 团队装配工主导产品的装配与组装，统筹零件、工艺与节拍，运用工具与协作手段，完成装配并自检质量落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机器人能自动装，但怎么调、怎么协、异常怎么处，还是装配工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Laser equipment can level concrete, but workers still decide how to finish the surface and when to act.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 206,700 Cement Masons And Concrete Finishers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 210,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,700 jobs, with approximately 14,300 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $54,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cement Masons And Concrete Finishers, but it will modestly improve speed. Laser screeds and concrete pumps accelerate standard surfaces, shifting workers from broad leveling toward skilled finishing, defect repair, and on-site judgment. Mechanization displaces pure physical screeding, while people with craft knowledge and feel remain stable.
ai_s3_list: Finish by feel: people create the final smooth surface
Field judgment: people assess the terrain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI exposure tier. Systems accelerate some steps, but people still make essential judgments and take final responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure means limited replacement risk. Systems remove only a small amount of physical work because concrete finishing depends heavily on touch and field conditions.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The work is stable but demanding. Develop finishing technique early because pure screeding is declining in the AI era.
Advance from screeding to finishing + repair, and learn mix design and curing.
Highlight surface quality and schedule performance because supervisors value reliable, fast work.
Hire for feel and responsibility, not strength alone. Core workers who deliver quality deserve better rates.

ai_s7_trends: Laser screeds are spreading, reducing manual screeding.
Skilled surface finishing still depends on people.
Workers who understand the process remain more stable.

body: Cement Masons And Concrete Finishers lead concrete placement and finishing. They coordinate forms, mix design, and surface work, using tools and craft techniques to produce flat, durable finished surfaces.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Laser equipment can level concrete, but workers still decide how to finish the surface and when to act.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 激光能整平，但手感怎么收、时机怎么掐，还是工人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年水泥泥瓦工混凝土修整工在岗约 20.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 21.04 万人，净增约 0.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.47 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代混凝土修整工，但会少量提速。激光整平与泵送把标准面提速，工人从「刮大面」挪向「手感收光、缺陷修复、现场判断」。真正被挤掉的是纯体力刮平，懂工艺、有手感的人更稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光说明风险低：系统只替少量体力，混凝土修整高度依赖手感与现场，人的位置很稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行稳但辛苦，早点练手感工艺，AI 时代纯刮平在缩。
从「刮平」升级成「收光 + 修复」，学配比与养护。
突出平整质量与工期，工头看重稳和快。
选人别只看力，看手感和责任心，骨干值得给好面。

ai_s7_trends: 激光整平普及，刮平缩。
手感收光仍靠人。
懂工艺的工更稳。

body: 水泥泥瓦工与混凝土修整工主导混凝土的浇筑与修整，统筹支模、配比与收光，运用工具与工艺手段，做出平整牢固的面层落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 激光能整平，但手感怎么收、时机怎么掐，还是工人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can upload data automatically, but technicians still decide how to collect samples, investigate anomalies, and report exceedances.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, about 40,400 Environmental Science And Protection Technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 42,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,700 jobs, with about 5,600 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $49,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental Science And Protection Technicians, but it will greatly accelerate monitoring and data uploads. Automated monitoring shifts people from routine readings toward sampling-site selection, anomaly investigation, field judgment, and compliance assistance. Reading-only roles face the most pressure, while technicians who collect reliable samples and investigate problems become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Sampling-site selection: people choose representative locations.
Anomaly investigation: people collect confirmation samples.
Field judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Compliance assistance: people uphold the standard.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Systems greatly accelerate automated monitoring and data uploads, but people still collect samples and investigate anomalies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces routine reading tasks, not the work of diagnosing environmental conditions. Technicians who collect reliable samples and investigate anomalies become scarcer as automation expands.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study chemistry and instrumentation. Routine reading work is shrinking, so develop sampling and investigation skills early.
Move beyond readings into sampling, investigation, and compliance, then seek responsibility for a geographic area.
Emphasize certifications and a clean compliance record. Employers value reliability and attention to detail.
Do not hire on certifications alone. Evaluate whether candidates can collect valid samples and investigate anomalies. Technicians who can protect quality deserve higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated monitoring is becoming common, reducing routine reading work.
Sampling and anomaly investigation are receiving more attention.
People who can protect data quality are increasingly sought after.

body: Environmental Science And Protection Technicians collect water, air, soil, and other samples and operate monitoring equipment. They test emissions and pollution according to standards, investigate anomalies, and help keep environmental impacts within permitted limits.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can upload data automatically, but technicians still decide how to collect samples, investigate anomalies, and report exceedances.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 上传能自动，但样怎么采、异常怎么查、超标怎么报，还是技术员的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年环境科学与保护技术员在岗约 4.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.21 万人，净增约 0.17 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.56 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.95 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会大幅加速监测与上传。自动监测与数据上传把常规操作提速，人从「读数」挪向「采样布点、异常核查、现场判断、合规协助」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准读数的，会采样、能核查的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——自动监测与上传被系统大幅加速，但采样与核查还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准读数」动作，不是「环境把脉」的岗位。会采样、能核查的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学化学与仪器，纯读数在缩，早点练采样和核查。
从「读数」升级成「采样 + 核查 + 合规」，争取片区负责。
突出持证与无违规，企业看重稳和细。
选人别只看证，要看会不会采样和核查，能把关的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动监测普及，读数缩。
采样核查更被看重。
会把关的人更抢手。

body: 环境科学与保护技术员采集水、气、土壤等样品并操作监测设备，按规范检测排放与污染，核查异常并协助把环境影响控制在标准内。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 上传能自动，但样怎么采、异常怎么查、超标怎么报，还是技术员的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated controls can close the temperature loop, but machines still cannot match an experienced operator who checks the color and says the batch needs a little longer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 20,700 Food And Tobacco Roasting, Baking, And Drying Machine Operators And Tenders employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 20,800 by 2034, a net gain of about 100 jobs, with about 2,400 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $42,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Food And Tobacco Roasting, Baking, And Drying Machine Operators And Tenders, but it will automate closed-loop temperature and humidity control. Sensors and PLC systems stabilize process curves. Operators shift from manual dampers toward exception review, sample judgment, troubleshooting, and supervision of multiple machines. Screen watchers who only press buttons face replacement, while people who tune parameters and judge quality gain value.
ai_s2_accel: Machine vision that assists evaluation of roast color
Predictive maintenance alerts for wear-part replacement
Digital-twin simulation for dryer energy optimization
Scanned changeover checklists that prevent errors
ai_s2_auto: PLC closed-loop control of temperature and humidity curves
Automatic detection with online moisture and color sensors
Digital distribution of batch recipes and process cards
ai_s3_list: Integrated sample judgment: people assess color, aroma, flavor, and moisture together.
Exception handling: people clear jams and broken belts on site.
Parameter tuning and feel: experienced operators know when a batch needs a little longer.
Changeover cleaning: process discipline and responsibility prevent flavor carryover.
Multi-machine coordination: people schedule attention across several lines.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Automated controls stabilize process curves, but people retain sample judgment and troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces screen watching and button pressing, not quality judgment and troubleshooting. Operators who tune parameters, clear faults, and manage multiple machines become scarcer. Workers who only watch screens face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in vocational electromechanics or food processing, then learn equipment operation from experienced workers. Screen-watching roles are shrinking, so develop parameter-control and troubleshooting skills early.
Advance from watching one machine to managing multiple machines + troubleshooting. Learn PLC and basic maintenance, then pursue process or maintenance roles.
Emphasize equipment experience and quality awareness. State the power and scale of machines you operated and the exceptions you handled. Factories value reliable, experienced workers.
Do not hire only for physical strength. Assess parameter adjustment and sample judgment. Operators who troubleshoot independently justify higher grades.

ai_s7_trends: Continuous production lines are spreading, consolidating single-machine monitoring roles.
Machine vision and sensors automate more quality checks.
Operators who tune parameters, troubleshoot, and manage multiple machines are in greater demand.

body: Food And Tobacco Roasting, Baking, And Drying Machine Operators And Tenders run heating and drying equipment in manufacturing plants. They set and monitor temperature, humidity, and time and sample products for doneness and moisture.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated controls can close the temperature loop, but machines still cannot match an experienced operator who checks the color and says the batch needs a little longer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自控系统能把温度曲线做成自动闭环，但师傅拿起一块看颜色说「还差一口气」，机器还学不会。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年食品、机器操作员看护员在岗约 2.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.08 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类操作员，但会接管温度湿度的自动闭环控制。传感器和 PLC 把曲线稳住，操作员从「手动调风门」挪向「看异常、判样品、排故障、管多台」。真正被挤掉的是只会按按钮不会调参的看机人，能排故能判品质的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 机器视觉辅助判定烘焙色泽
预测性维护提醒易损件更换
数字孪生模拟烘房能耗优化
换批清场清单的扫码防错
ai_s2_auto: 温度湿度曲线的 PLC 自动闭环控制
在线水分与颜色传感器的自动检测
设备运行参数的自动记录与报警
批次配方与工艺卡的电子化下发
ai_s3_list: 样品综合判定：色香味水分要人综合判断。
异常处置：卡料断带要人现场排。
调参与手感：老师傅的「差一口气」经验。
换批清场防串味：靠流程和责任心。
多台协同：同时盯几条线靠人调度。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的设备看管区——自控系统能稳住曲线，但样品判定和排故还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「盯屏按按钮」动作，不是「判品质排故障」的岗位。会调参、能排故、管多台的人，反而随自动化变得更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏、不动手的老看机人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中职机电或食品类打底，进厂从学徒跟师傅学看机。AI 时代纯看机在缩，早点练调参和排故。
从「看一台」升级成「管多台 + 排故障」，学 PLC 和机修基础，争取转工艺或机修岗。
突出设备经验和品质意识，写清看过多大功率设备、出过什么异常。工厂看重稳和熟。
招人别只看体力，要看会不会调参和判样品。能独立排故的操作员，值得给高岗级。

ai_s7_trends: 连续化产线普及，单台看机岗位合并减少。
机器视觉与传感器让品质判定更自动。
能调参排故、管多台的操作员更抢手。

body: 食品、机器操作员看护员是食品与烟草烘焙、烘烤与烘干机操作员及看护员在制造现场看管烘烤干燥类设备，设定并监控温度、湿度、时间等工艺参数。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自控系统能把温度曲线做成自动闭环，但师傅拿起一块看颜色说「还差一口气」，机器还学不会。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can assist with scheduling and paperwork, but managers still guide families through farewells and oversee compliance and reputation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 32,100 funeral home managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 33,400 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,300 jobs, with roughly 2,600 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $76,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace funeral home managers; it will assist with back-office work. Systems can speed up scheduling, accounting, and records, but local trust, in-person care, compliance oversight, and staff management still require people. Purely clerical roles face the most pressure, while managers with business skill and empathy are more resilient.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in a low AI exposure area of management. Systems can accelerate back-office work, but human care and local trust continue to create a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean zero risk. Scheduling and reconciliation tasks face automation, not the role of running an establishment. Managers who understand operations, care, and compliance are difficult to replace. Clerical-only assistants face greater pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in funeral services, social work, or management, and build compliance and communication skills. Pure clerical work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop operational skills early.
Move from managing a service to managing an establishment. Learn compliance and reputation management, then work toward regional operations.
Emphasize reliability and service experience, and describe the parts of the process you have handled. Employers value dependability.
Do not hire for talk alone. Look for people who understand care. Core staff who can steady families deserve performance rewards.

ai_s7_trends: Population aging supports steady demand.
Digital tools accelerate back-office work.
Managers with strong caregiving skills are increasingly sought after.

body: Funeral home managers run funeral homes or funeral service organizations. They coordinate ceremonies, staff, vehicles, and compliance while overseeing family care and accounting to ensure dependable service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can assist with scheduling and paperwork, but managers still guide families through farewells and oversee compliance and reputation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排期与文书能被系统辅助，但陪家属走完告别、管合规和口碑，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年殡葬家庭经理在岗约 3.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.34 万人，净增约 0.13 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代殡葬家庭经理，只会辅助后台。排期、账务、档案可被系统提速，但本地信任、现场安抚、合规把控与人员管理仍靠人。真正被挤掉的是纯文书岗，有经营力与同理心的人更稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的经营区——系统能提速后台，但人文照护与本地信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于零风险：被替代的是「排期、对账」动作，不是「机构运营」的岗位。有经营力、能照护、懂合规的人，几乎不会被替代。怕的是只会做纯文书的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 殡葬、社工、管理起步多练合规和沟通，AI 时代纯文书在缩，早点练经营。
从「管一场」升级成「管一家」，学合规与口碑，争取区域运营。
突出稳重与服务经历，写清跟过哪些环节。机构看重可靠。
选人别只看嘴皮，要看有没有照护脑子。能稳住家属的骨干，值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 老龄化带来稳健需求。
数字化提速后台。
有照护力的经理更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「数钱点数」动作，不是「合规核对」的岗位。会核对、能甄别异常的人，反而随无现金更稀缺。怕的是只会点数的收银。

从「数钱」升级成「核对 + 服务」，学反洗线和异常甄别。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can create a test and grade a class's work in a minute, but teachers still need to respond when a student lowers their head or a parent becomes emotional.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,094,500 high school teachers, excluding special and career/technical education, employed in 2024, projected to decline to 1,076,700 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 17,800 jobs, with roughly 66,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $64,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace high school teachers, but it will reshape what and how they teach. AI is taking over question writing, grading, and knowledge explanations, shifting teachers from delivering information toward guiding student development. Machines cannot replace real-time classroom guidance, emotional support, differentiated teaching, and family communication. Teachers who use AI as an assistant save time for students and become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of virtual simulation classrooms
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent grading of assignments and essays
ai_s3_list: Real-time classroom guidance: people must respond when students lose focus or answer off target.
Emotional support and counseling: AI cannot embrace adolescents through uncertainty.
Differentiated teaching: teachers understand each student's weaknesses and potential.
Family communication: experience and empathy guide conversations with anxious parents.
Values and character education: example matters more than words and requires people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means AI is taking over about half of the occupation's knowledge-processing tasks, including question writing, grading, and explanations, while the core of student development remains human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Pure knowledge delivery shrinks while educational guidance remains. The faster AI grades, the more time teachers should spend understanding students. Teachers who lead classes, develop students, and communicate effectively become scarcer in the AI era.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Teacher education remains a good choice, but look beyond the job title. Consider hard subjects such as mathematics and science, demographic trends, and regional staffing. Choose this path when the student is patient and enjoys working with people.

Use AI as a teaching assistant for questions, grading, and lesson preparation, while focusing personally on classroom guidance and class management. Develop communication and counseling skills that AI cannot replace.

Teacher certification is the first step. Applicants without teacher-training backgrounds can consider shortage subjects or private schools. Resumes should emphasize class leadership, student outcomes, and family communication cases, which can matter more than credentials alone.

Do not recruit only on scores and degrees; assess class-leadership ability and commitment to student development. Equip teachers with effective AI tools to remove mechanical work and improve educational quality.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic test assembly by knowledge point
Analysis of scores and weak areas
English pronunciation correction and speaking practice
Virtual physics, chemistry, and biology experiments

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over question writing, grading, and explanations, shifting teachers from information delivery to student-development guidance.
Declining birth rates reduce enrollment and intensify competition for teaching positions, while education evolves toward higher quality and smaller classes.
As personalized learning spreads, teachers become learning-path designers and AI literacy becomes essential.

body: High school teachers, excluding special and career/technical education, teach subjects such as language arts, mathematics, and English. They design and deliver instruction, grade work, evaluate examinations, and manage classes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟出好一套卷子、批完全班作业，但学生低着头的那个瞬间该怎么接、家长情绪激动时怎么谈，还得靠老师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高中教师（不含特殊与职业技术教育）职业诊断在岗约 109.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 107.67 万人，岗位净减约 1.78 万个，年均产生约 6.62 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.46 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高中教师，但会重塑「教什么、怎么教」。出题、批改、知识点讲解正被 AI 接管，教师从「知识搬运」转向「育人引导」；课堂的临场引导、情绪陪伴、因材施教和家校沟通，机器替代不了。会把 AI 当助手的老师，省下时间育人，反而更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 课堂的临场引导：学生跑神、答偏，当场接住靠人。
情绪陪伴与心理疏导：青春期的迷茫，AI 给不了拥抱。
因材施教：每个学生的短板和潜能，只有老师清楚。
家校沟通：家长焦虑时怎么谈，靠经验和共情。
价值观与品格教育：身教重于言传，靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半「知识加工」任务正被 AI 接管——出题、批改、讲解都能自动化，但育人的核心环节仍在人手上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。被压缩的是「纯知识传授」部分，留下的是育人价值——AI 批改越快，教师越该把时间花在「读懂学生」上。能带班、会育人、善沟通的老师，在 AI 时代更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 师范类还是好选择，但别只盯「当老师」三个字：选数理化等硬学科、关注人口趋势和地区编制。孩子有耐心、喜欢跟人打交道，再考虑这行。
把 AI 当助教：出题、批改、备课交给它，自己深耕课堂引导和班级管理。练好沟通与心理疏导，这是 AI 替代不了的核心。
考教资是第一步，无师范背景可考虑紧缺学科或民办学校。简历多写带班经历、学生成果和家校沟通案例，比学历更打动人。
招人别只看分数和学历，要看带班能力和育人意愿。给教师配好 AI 教学工具，把老师从机械劳动里解放出来，育人质量才上得去。

ai_s7_trends: AI 接管出题批改与知识讲解，教师从「知识搬运工」转向「育人引导者」。
人口出生率下降带来生源收缩，教师岗位竞争加剧，向高质量、小班化演进。
个性化学习普及，教师成为「学习路径设计师」，AI 素养成为必修课。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can check in in three seconds, but when a guest asks "Where is the best place to take children around here?", the live person at the front desk still has to answer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 264,200 hotel, motel, and resort clerks on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 274,000 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 9,800 jobs, an average annual vacancy of approximately 43,600, and a median annual salary of approximately US$34,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not make the hotel front desk disappear, but it will rewrite the job content. Self-service check-in machines, AI customer service and room status systems have taken over the standardized process, and the front desk's energy has turned to complex issues, complaint handling and experience services. What is truly irreplaceable is face-to-face warmth and adaptability to emergencies.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent room allocation and price recommendation
Intelligent dispatch and follow-up of complaint work orders
ai_s2_auto: Automatically synchronize online booking and room status
Automated processing of bills and invoices
AI customer service handles routine inquiries
ai_s3_list: On-site emergency response and crisis management: the front desk is the first to respond to power outages, overcrowding, or guests getting upset.
Service warmth and human touch: AI cannot learn the phrase "It's been a hard journey".
Judgment of complex problems: what can be solved within the authority and who should be escalated depends on experience.
Coordination with various departments: guest rooms, catering, maintenance, the front desk is the hub.
Emotional management and physical strength: Working three shifts and smiling is a skill in itself.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 shows that half of the work in this profession is on standardized processes-reservation, check-in, reconciliation, which is what AI and self-service devices are best at.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: the more automated the process, the more people are needed to deal with customers that cannot be accommodated by automation. Those who are squeezed are the front desk staff who can only click the mouse to complete the process. People who can serve and adapt are more in demand.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study hotel management and tourism management, and do many internships at school. In the AI ​​​​era, employees should no longer only handle formalities, but focus on practicing foreign languages, complaint handling and operational thinking, and move towards duty managers and guest relations.

Familiarize yourself with self-service devices and AI tools, and focus on experience services. Take the hotel management-related certificate and be promoted to duty manager, front office operation or sales. Don't stop at the entry position.

Experience in the service industry counts, but the focus is on expression and adaptability. Prepare a story about "the most difficult customer you have ever dealt with" for the interview, which is more impressive than a list of skills.

Don’t just look at your appearance when recruiting front desk staff, you should also take a look at on-site adaptability and emotional management. Candidates who can use the system, are good at foreign languages, and can handle three shifts deserve better promotion channels.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integration of room status, reservation and accounting
General questions and answers, booking guidance
Mobile phone door opening and permission management
House price recommendations, occupancy rate predictions

ai_s7_trends: With the popularization of self-service and AI customer service, the front desk has shifted from "process processing" to "service delivery".
High-end hotels and resorts have strengthened experience services, and personalization and temperature have become selling points.
Front office positions have been upgraded to the combined direction of operations, revenue, and guest relations.

body: Hotel front desk clerks are responsible for guests' check-in, check-out, reservations, inquiries and accounting processing, and coordinate various departments such as guest rooms and catering to meet guest needs. They are the front desk window positions for hotel reception services.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年酒店、汽车旅馆、度假村文员在岗约 26.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 27.40 万人，净增约 0.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让酒店前台消失，但会改写岗位内容。自助入住机、AI 客服和房态系统接管了标准化流程，前台的精力转向复杂问题、投诉处理和体验服务。真正难以替代的，是面对面的温度和对突发情况的应变。
ai_s2_accel: 智能客房分配与价格推荐
宾客画像辅助个性化服务
语音助手与多语言翻译
投诉工单的智能分派与跟进
ai_s2_auto: 线上预订与房态自动同步
账单与发票的自动化处理
AI 客服处理常规问询
ai_s3_list: 现场应变与危机处理：停电、爆满、客人闹情绪，前台是第一个接住的。
服务温度与人情味：一句「路上辛苦了」，AI 学不会。
复杂问题的判断：权限内能解决什么、该升级给谁，靠经验。
与各部门的协调：客房、餐饮、维修，前台是枢纽。
情绪管理与体力：三班倒加笑容，本身就是技能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在标准化流程上——预订、入住、对账，正是 AI 和自助设备最擅长的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：流程越自动化，越需要人去处理自动化兜不住的客人。被挤压的是只会点鼠标办流程的前台，会服务、会应变的人反而更抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学酒店管理、旅游管理，在校多实习。AI 时代别只会办手续，重点练外语、投诉处理和运营思维，往值班经理、宾客关系方向走。
把自助设备和 AI 工具用熟，把精力放到体验服务上。考酒店管理相关证书，往值班经理、前厅运营或销售方向晋升，别停在录入岗。
服务行业经验都算数，重点是表达和应变。面试准备好「处理过最难缠的客人」的故事，比列技能更打动人。
招前台别只看形象，要考现场应变和情绪管理。会用系统、外语好、扛得住三班倒的候选人，值得给更好的晋升通道。

ai_s7_trends: 自助化与 AI 客服普及，前台从「办流程」转向「做服务」。
高端酒店与度假村强化体验服务，个性化与温度成为卖点。
前厅岗位向运营、收益、宾客关系复合方向升级。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mathematicians; it will assist their work. AI can accelerate computation and literature review, shifting mathematicians from calculation toward proposing conjectures, selecting proof directions, and building structures. Mechanical calculation faces the greatest pressure, while people who create new structures become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Proposing conjectures: imagination depends on people.
Constructing proofs: rigor depends on people.
Structural insight: taste depends on people.
Cross-domain connections: intuition depends on people.
Leading directions: vision depends on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI exposure is relatively low. Tools provide assistance, while proposing ideas and proving them remain human work, and the field's theoretical nature strengthens its value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. This role has low exposure; mechanical calculation faces replacement, not work that creates new structures. People with mathematical taste remain more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with mathematics and practice proofs extensively. Pure calculation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop the ability to pose questions early.
Advance from calculation toward proposing conjectures and building structures, and learn to connect mathematics with applications.
Highlight papers and models, and specify the difficult problems you solved.
Do not assess candidates only on scores; look for mathematical taste.

ai_s7_trends: Demand for applied mathematics rises.
Computational assistance becomes standard.
People who create new structures become more sought after.

body: Mathematicians study abstract patterns in quantity, structure, space, and related fields. They use logical reasoning and modeling to solve theoretical and applied problems and produce proofs and models.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assist with computation and literature, but people still decide which conjectures to propose and how to prove them.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能辅助计算与文献，但提什么猜想、怎么证，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年数学家在岗约 0.24 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.24 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代数学家，反而辅助其工作。计算与文献可由 AI 提速，数学家从「算」挪向「提猜想、证方向、建结构」。真正被挤掉的是只做机械计算的，能开新结构的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光偏低——工具做辅助，提出与证明还留着人的位置，且纯粹属性增强价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：这个岗位曝光低，被替代的是「机械计算」动作，不是「开新结构」的岗位。有数学品味的人更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学起步多练证明，AI 时代纯计算在缩，早点练提出力。
从「算」升级成「提猜想 + 建结构」，学应用落地。
突出论文与模型，写清解过哪些难题。
选人别只看分数，要看有没有数学品味。

ai_s7_trends: 应用数学需求升。
计算辅助成标配。
能开结构者更抢手。

body: 数学家研究数量、结构与空间等的抽象规律，运用逻辑推理与建模解决理论与应用问题，产出证明与模型。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run standard models, but researchers still decide which problems deserve models, how to set assumptions, and how to explain conclusions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), the 2026 median annual wage is about $126,700 (BLS OES, 2026). BLS has not published a 2024 to 2034 employment-growth projection for this occupational definition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mathematical and statistical research, but it will reduce standard roles. Automated modeling and tests accelerate routine analysis, shifting researchers from running models toward problem definition, methodological innovation, interpretation, and decision support. Standard-test-only roles face pressure, while strong researchers gain value.
ai_s3_list: Problem definition: people frame the question.
Method innovation: people develop the approach.
Rigor and accountability: people stand behind conclusions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this career in the relatively high AI exposure tier for quantitative work. Systems accelerate standard analysis, while definition and research remain human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard test execution, not quantitative research. Researchers who define problems become scarcer as efficiency rises, while standard-model-only analysts face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong mathematics foundations and practice programming and writing. Pure model execution is contracting, so learn problem definition early.
Advance from running models to defining problems and supporting decisions. Learn business context and pursue ownership of research topics.
Highlight research directions and results, clearly identifying the models built. Clients value stability and precision.
When hiring, look beyond education and assess problem-definition ability. Core researchers who take responsibility for conclusions deserve higher levels.

ai_s7_trends: Automated modeling becomes widespread.
Problem definition remains human.
Strong researchers are in greater demand.

body: Mathematicians and statisticians use mathematical and statistical methods for modeling, inference, and proof, supporting scientific, policy, and business decisions while managing uncertainty and reproducibility.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can run standard models, but researchers still decide which problems deserve models, how to set assumptions, and how to explain conclusions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能跑标准模型，但哪问题值得建、假设怎么设、结论怎么讲，还是研究者定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.67 万美元（BLS OES，2026）；BLS 未发布该职业口径的 2024–2034 年就业增长预测。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代数学与统计研究，但会压缩标准岗。自动建模与标准检验把常规分析提速，研究者从「跑模型」挪向「问题定义、方法创新、结果解释、决策对接」。真正被挤掉的是只跑标准检验的，有研究力的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的量化区——标准分析被系统加速，但定义与研究还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑标准检验」动作，不是「量化研究」的岗位。有研究力、能定义问题的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑标准模型的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 把数学基础打牢，多练编程与写作，AI 时代纯跑模型在缩，早点练定义。
从「跑模型」升级成「定问题 + 对决策」，学业务语境，争取专题。
突出方向与成果，写清建过哪些模型。甲方看重稳和准。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有定义脑子。能担结论的骨干，值得给高定级。

ai_s7_trends: 自动建模普及。
问题定义留人。
有研究力的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify targets and calculate firepower in one second, but only people who have led and served in a unit understand whether it is ready to engage today and what its morale is like.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military compensation is determined by the Department of Defense pay-grade system based on rank and years of service. Civilian BLS OES data do not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median figure. Salary references use proxy data for mainland China (public sources including China's military compensation system, sample size 0, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace military tactical operations and air/weapons specialists. Battlefield tactics, equipment operation, and team coordination depend on human training and trust, while people alone can bear responsibility for decisions. AI can greatly improve intelligence, target identification, and logistics efficiency, but machines will not make the decision to fight for people.
ai_s2_accel: Drones and unmanned equipment entering tactical systems
AI-assisted firepower calculations and target assignment
Widespread adoption of digital systems for individual service members
AI simulation training improving training efficiency
ai_s2_auto: Automated recording and analysis of training data
Automated generation of readiness reports and documents
ai_s3_list: Tactical judgment: making decisions when battlefield information is incomplete.
Equipment feel: experience operating weapons and systems.
Team trust: rapport built through long-term coordination.
Discipline: absolute obedience and execution under pressure.
Physical skills: genuine fitness and combat proficiency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score makes military operations a low-AI-exposure, field-oriented occupation. AI is taking over much of the intelligence, identification, and logistics work, but weapons operation, tactical execution, and battlefield coordination still depend heavily on human training and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Drones and digital equipment are reshaping warfare, and service members who can operate unmanned equipment and understand digital systems have an advantage in promotion. The value of purely physical roles is declining.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If your child wants to join the military, start by meeting the medical and political-screening requirements, then pursue enlistment. Be clear that military life demands strict discipline and hard training and is not a way to avoid employment. Learn about service branches and specialties in advance and choose a technically demanding role.

Seize the digital-transformation opportunity by learning drone operation, digital equipment, and professional certifications, then pursue a technical noncommissioned officer path. Plan the transition out of service as well, building military-civilian transferable skills such as driving, communications, equipment repair, and safety management in advance.

Veterans are highly valued in security, emergency response, and equipment manufacturing, but should not rely solely on past experience. In interviews, translate military experience into business language: discipline, execution, emergency response, and teamwork. These are powerful resume strengths.

When hiring veterans, look beyond physical fitness and recognize the value of discipline, execution, and emergency-response capability. Create clear transition and training paths for them; these employees are often far more stable than typical new hires.

ai_s7_trends: Digital and unmanned equipment is reshaping warfare, increasing demand for technical roles.
AI is becoming deeply integrated into reconnaissance, target identification, and simulated training.
Dual-use military and civilian skills are becoming essential assets for career transitions.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（中国军人薪酬体系等公开渠道，采样 0 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代军事战术与武器专业人员：战场上的战术执行、装备操作和班组协同依赖人的训练与信任，决策责任更是只能由人来承担。AI 能大幅提升情报、目标识别和后勤效率，但打仗这件事，机器不会替人做决定。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机与无人装备进入战术体系
AI 辅助火力测算与目标分配
AI 模拟训练提升训练效率
ai_s2_auto: 情报整理与目标识别辅助
后勤与装备台账电子化
训练数据自动记录分析
战备报表与文书自动生成
ai_s3_list: 战术判断：战场信息不全时的临机决断。
装备手感：武器与系统操作的经验。
班组信任：长期协同建立的默契。
纪律执行：高压下的绝对服从与执行。
身体技能：实打实的体能与战技术。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明军事作业是「低 AI 曝光」的实战型职业：情报、识别、后勤正被 AI 大幅接管，但武器操作、战术执行和战场协同依然高度依赖人的训练与判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不变：无人机、信息化装备改变了作战形态，会操作无人装备、懂信息化系统的军人更有晋升优势；纯体能岗位的价值在下降。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想从军，先过体检政审关，再从参军入伍开始。要讲清楚：军队生活纪律严明、训练辛苦，不是「逃避就业」的选项；建议提前了解军兵种和专业方向，选有技术含量的岗位。
抓住信息化转型机会：学无人机操作、信息化装备和专业技能证书，往技术军士方向走。同时规划好退役衔接，把军地通用的技能（驾驶、通信、装备维修、安全管理）提前储备。
退役军人在安保、应急、装备制造领域很受欢迎，但别吃老本。面试时把部队经历翻译成企业语言：纪律性、执行力、应急处理、团队协作，这些就是最好的简历。
招退役军人别只看体能，要看到纪律性、执行力和应急素质的价值。给退役军人设计清晰的转岗培养路径，这类人才稳定性远高于普通新员工。

ai_s7_trends: 信息化与无人化装备改变作战形态，技术型岗位需求上升。
AI 深度融入侦察、目标识别与模拟训练。
军地两用技能成为职业衔接的关键资本。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 3D printers can produce prototypes in seconds, but a model maker's hands and eyes still determine whether seams are smooth and parts fit tightly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 3,200 metal and plastic model makers employed in 2024, projected to decline to 2,600 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 600 jobs, with roughly 300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $62,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace metal and plastic model makers, but it will accelerate fabrication. 3D printing and CNC automate routine prototypes, shifting model makers from making parts toward fitting, trial-assembly judgment, and coordination across multiple processes. Entry-level workers limited to simple parts face displacement, while people who can fit and test assemblies become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Appearance control: depends on the eye.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in a medium-to-high-exposure fabrication category. Printing, turning, and milling absorb routine parts, but people retain responsibility for fitting and trial assembly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean no change. Automation accelerates simple part fabrication, not fitting and trial-assembly validation roles. People with skilled hands who can test assemblies become more secure, while entry-level workers limited to simple parts face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose moldmaking or machining in vocational school and learn 3D printing and measuring tools. Pure fabrication is shrinking in the AI era, so practice fitting early.
Advance from making parts to fitting + trial assembly. Learn multiple processes and pursue prototype-supervisor roles.
Highlight the processes you know and whether you can deliver prototypes independently. Factories value steadiness and precision.
Do not assess candidates solely by machine familiarity; determine whether they can fit and test assemblies. Experienced workers who deliver completed prototypes deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: 3D printing spreads, reducing simple-part work.
Prototype-validation demand remains stable.
People who can fit and test assemblies are more sought after.

body: Model makers create product prototypes, appearance models, and mold models from drawings, using turning, milling, additive manufacturing, and manual fitting to control dimensions and appearance and support R&D prototyping and assembly validation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 3D 打印能秒出样件，但那缝补得平不平、配合紧不紧，还得模型工的手和眼去定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年模型制造工、金属塑料在岗约 0.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.26 万人，岗位净减约 0.06 万个，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.27 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代金属塑料模型工，但会加速制件。3D 打印与 CNC 把常规样件自动化，模型工从「做件」挪向「修配、试装判断、多工艺统筹」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单制件的初级工，会修配能试装的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的制件区——打印车铣吃常规件，但修配与试装还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被加速的是「简单制件」动作，不是「修配与试装验证」的岗位。有手感、能试装的人，反而更稳。怕的是只会跑简单件的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职高选模具机加，在校多学 3D 打印和量具。AI 时代纯制件在缩，早点练修配。
从「做件」升级成「修配 + 试装」，学多工艺，争取当样机主管。
突出会哪些工艺、能不能独立交样。工厂看重稳和准。
选人别只看机器熟，要看会不会修配试装。能交样的师傅，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 3D 打印普及，简单件缩。
试制验证需求稳。
会修配能试装的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: No matter how smart a ventilator becomes, a respiratory therapist still decides whether to initiate ventilation, when to wean the patient, and how to reassure an uncooperative patient.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 139,600 respiratory therapists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 156,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 16,800 jobs, with approximately 8,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $80,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace respiratory therapists, but it will take over routine adjustments. Smart ventilators already provide closed-loop ventilation and alarms, leaving routine settings to the system. Therapists are shifting from turning knobs to assessing conditions, deciding when to wean, providing pulmonary rehabilitation, and managing communication with patients and families. Standardized operators face displacement, while therapists who can assess and communicate become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Clinical assessment: people make the judgment.
Timing of weaning: people weigh the tradeoffs.
Emergency support: people provide the response.
Customized rehabilitation: people design the plan.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates medium AI exposure. Smart equipment takes over routine work, but people retain an essential role in bedside judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is the task of standard parameter adjustment, not the role of assessing conditions and making weaning decisions. Respiratory therapists who can assess and communicate become even scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with a medical or respiratory therapy program, earn the required credential early, and develop assessment skills as purely operational work shrinks in the AI era.
Advance from adjusting settings to assessment and rehabilitation. Learn ECMO and pulmonary rehabilitation, and pursue an ICU specialization.
Highlight your credentials and ICU experience, and specify the conditions you have treated.
Do not assess candidates only on equipment familiarity. Look for assessment and communication skills, and offer night-shift premiums to core staff who can handle the ICU.

ai_s7_trends: Smart equipment is spreading, reducing routine work.
Chronic illness and population aging increase demand.
Therapists skilled in assessment and rehabilitation are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准参数调节」动作，不是「病情评估与脱机决策」的岗位。会评估、能沟通的治疗师，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学/呼吸治疗专业起步，趁早考证书，AI 时代纯操作在缩，练评估。
从调参升级成评估与康复，学 ECMO 与肺康复，争取 ICU 方向。
突出证书与 ICU 经验，写清跟过哪些病种。
选人别只看设备熟，要看会不会评估和沟通，能顶 ICU 的骨干值得给夜班补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 智能设备普及，常规缩。
慢病与老龄推高需求。
会评估康复的治疗师更抢手。

body: 呼吸治疗师评估并治疗有呼吸或心肺疾患的病人，操作呼吸机、氧疗与排痰设备，参与急救与呼吸康复。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 呼吸机再聪明，上不上机、何时脱机、怎么安抚不肯配合的病人，还是治疗师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Computer vision can flag suspicious actions, but a specialist still relies on experience to decide whether it is a false alarm or actual theft and whether to question the person.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 84,000 retail specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 86,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,100 jobs, with approximately 23,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $41,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace loss prevention specialists, but it will assist with detection. Video surveillance and anomaly analysis speed up screen monitoring, shifting specialists from watching screens alone to lead verification, strategy design, and investigative interviews. People who only perform basic monitoring will be displaced, while those who can analyze and verify information will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Lead verification: people determine what is true and what is false.
Investigative interviews: people safeguard legal and ethical boundaries.
Strategy design: people decide on the approach.
On-site emergency response: people handle unexpected events.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed analytical category. Systems accelerate screen monitoring, while people remain responsible for verification and strategy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Basic monitoring and inventory-counting tasks are being replaced, not roles centered on verification and strategy. As systems become more prevalent, people who can analyze evidence and respect boundaries become even scarcer. Those who only know how to watch screens face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in security and develop observation and analytical skills. Screen-only monitoring is contracting in the AI era, so learn investigative verification early.
Advance from watching screens to investigating leads and designing strategies; learn data analysis and investigative interviewing.
Highlight loss prevention cases and data analysis, clearly stating how much shrinkage you reduced.

Do not select candidates solely for their ability to watch screens for long periods. Evaluate whether they can analyze information and respect boundaries. Specialists who reduce losses deserve performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: As computer vision becomes widespread, screen-monitoring roles shrink.
Loss prevention shifts toward strategy and verification.
Specialists who can analyze evidence and respect boundaries have greater stability.

body: Retail loss prevention specialists identify sources of store shrinkage through monitoring, audits, and patrols; prevent employee and external theft and process vulnerabilities; develop loss prevention strategies; and coordinate with security and operations to reduce retail losses.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Computer vision can flag suspicious actions, but a specialist still relies on experience to decide whether it is a false alarm or actual theft and whether to question the person.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 视觉识别能标出可疑动作，但那是误报还是真偷、要不要问询，还是专员凭经验定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年零售专员在岗约 8.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.61 万人，净增约 0.21 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代防损专员，但会辅助识别。视频监控与异常分析把盯屏提速，专员从「纯看屏幕」挪向「线索核查 + 策略设计 + 问询处理」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础监控的人，会分析能核查的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的分析区——盯屏被系统提速，核查策略还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「基础监控与盘点」动作，不是「核查与策略」的岗位。会分析、能守边界的人反而随系统化更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏幕的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从安保做起，练观察和分析。AI 时代纯盯屏在缩，早点练核查。
从「看屏」升级成「查线索 + 做策略」，学数据和问询。
突出防损案例和数据分析，写清降过多少损耗。
选人别只看盯得久，看会不会分析和守边界。能降损的专员值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 视觉识别普及，盯屏缩。
防损转向策略与核查。
会分析能守边界的专员更稳。

body: 零售防损专员通过监控、审计与巡查识别门店损耗来源，防范内盗外盗与流程漏洞，制定防损策略并协同安保运营降低零售损失。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 视觉识别能标出可疑动作，但那是误报还是真偷、要不要问询，还是专员凭经验定的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A script can clean ten thousand rows of messy data perfectly, but assistants and statisticians still decide which definition to apply to a column.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 6,500 statistical assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 6,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with about 800 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $51,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace statistical assistants, but it will take over data entry and cleaning. Scripts and AI automatically clean messy data, shifting assistants from entering numbers toward enforcing definitions, identifying anomalies, reviewing work, and conducting quality checks. People who only enter data and run basic tables face displacement, while those who understand definitions and can detect false values become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification and mapping of definitions
Natural-language generation of basic data summaries
ai_s2_auto: Scripts for cleaning messy data and filling missing values
Automated generation of descriptive statistics and basic reports
ai_s3_list: Understanding definitions: people decide which calculation to use.
Identifying anomalies: people uncover false values.
Review and quality assurance: people find errors and omissions.
Business context: people interpret what the numbers mean.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure area of foundational data tables. Systems are taking over data entry and cleaning at scale, but people retain an essential role in definitions and quality assurance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is entering data and running tables, not roles that safeguard definitions. People who understand definitions and can find anomalies become scarcer as automation increases. Those who only enter numbers without thinking face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with an associate degree in statistics, business, or economics, and practice Excel and statistical software while in school. Data-entry work is shrinking in the AI era, so learn definitions and scripting early.
Advance from data entry to safeguarding definitions plus quality assurance. Learn Python/SQL and seek a transition into data analysis.
Highlight cleaning and verification experience and specify the volumes of data you have handled. Organizations value accuracy and attention to detail.
When hiring, look beyond data-entry speed and assess whether candidates understand definitions. People who can safeguard quality deserve skilled-worker pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Enter data and create pivot tables

ai_s7_trends: Data entry and cleaning become highly automated.
Safeguarding definitions and quality assurance receive greater weight.
Statistical assistants who can write scripts are in greater demand.

body: Statistical assistants help collect, enter, and clean data, verify samples and records using consistent definitions, calculate descriptive statistics and basic reports, identify outliers, and provide accurate, reliable source data for statistical analysis and decision-making.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A script can clean ten thousand rows of messy data perfectly, but assistants and statisticians still decide which definition to apply to a column.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 脚本能把一万行脏数据洗得干干净净，但那一列口径到底按哪个口径算，还是助理和统计师拍。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年统计助理在岗约 0.65 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.63 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代统计助理，但会接管录入与清洗。脚本和 AI 把脏数据自动洗好，助理从「录数」挪向「口径把关、异常甄别、复核质检」。真正被挤掉的是只做录数和跑基础表的人，能理解口径、查得出假数的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的口径识别与映射
自然语言生成基础数据摘要
图表与看板的自动绘制
ai_s2_auto: 数据录入与结构化的自动化
脏数据清洗与缺失填补的脚本
描述统计与基础报表的自动生成
ai_s3_list: 口径理解：按哪个算靠人定。
样本核对：一致性靠人对。
业务语境：数字含义靠人读。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的数据底表区——录入清洗被系统大规模接管，但口径与质检还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录数跑表」动作，不是「口径把关」的岗位。能理解口径、查得出异常的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会录数、不思考的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 统计经管大专打底，在校多练 Excel 和统计软件。AI 时代录数在缩，早点学口径和脚本。
从「录数」升级成「口径把关 + 质检」，学 Python/SQL，争取转数据分析。
突出清洗和核对经验，写清处理过哪些数据量。机构看重准和细。
招人别只看会录数，要看懂不懂口径。能把关质检的，值得给高技能工资。

ai_s7_trends: 录入清洗高度自动化。
口径把关与质检更受重视。
会脚本的统计助理更抢手。

body: 统计助理协助收集、录入与清洗数据，按统一口径核对样本与台账，计算描述统计与基础报表，排查异常值，为统计分析与决策提供准确可靠的底层数据。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 脚本能把一万行脏数据洗得干干净净，但那一列口径到底按哪个口径算，还是助理和统计师拍。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Diagnostic systems can locate a break, but line installers and repairers still decide how to climb, splice, assess conditions on site, and perform emergency repairs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 99,900 telecommunications line installers and repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 96,800 by 2034, a net decrease of about 3,100 jobs, with approximately 8,900 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $70,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace line installers and repairers, but it will accelerate diagnosis. Digital instruments and dispatch systems take over fault location, shifting workers from finding breaks toward climbing, fiber splicing, on-site emergency repairs, and complex problem-solving. Simple operations face displacement, while people who can work aloft or underground and restore service become more secure.
ai_s3_list: Pole climbing and splicing: Steady hands are essential.
On-site judgment: People provide the experience.
Emergency repair: People determine the response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 indicates high AI exposure in installation and maintenance. Systems accelerate diagnosis and dispatch, but people retain work aloft and underground.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces finding breaks, not pole-climbing repair roles. Hands-on professionals who resolve problems on site become scarcer as efficiency improves. Simple-operation workers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin at vocational school, develop hands-on skills, and earn credentials. Pure fault finding is shrinking in the AI era, so practice on-site response early.
Advance from finding breaks to emergency repair + instrument expertise. Learn fiber optics and 5G, and work toward responsibility for a service area.
Highlight credentials and emergency repair experience, and specify the service areas you have managed. Carriers value reliability and rapid response.
Do not evaluate candidates solely by physical strength. Assess their safety judgment. Core workers who operate independently deserve supplements.

ai_s7_trends: Fiber optics and 5G drive construction.
Widespread adoption of digital diagnostics.
Emergency repair capability is in greater demand.

body: Telecommunications line installers and repairers install, maintain, and repair communications cables and pole-line infrastructure. They use test instruments to locate faults and restore connectivity, keeping telephone, broadband, and mobile networks stable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Diagnostic systems can locate a break, but line installers and repairers still decide how to climb, splice, assess conditions on site, and perform emergency repairs.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 诊断系统能定位断点，但爬杆熔接、现场判断与应急抢修，还是线路工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年传播修理在岗约 9.99 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.68 万人，岗位净减约 0.31 万个，年均产生约 0.89 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代线路工，但会提速诊断环节。数字化仪表与派单系统接管故障定位，线路工从「找断点」挪向「爬杆熔接、现场抢修、复杂处置」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单操作的，能爬高下井抢修的人更稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的装维区——诊断与派单被系统加速，但爬高下井仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「找断点」动作，不是「爬杆抢修」的岗位。有动手力、能现场处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做简单操作的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 技校起步练动手和考证，AI 时代纯找断点在缩，早点练现场处置。
从「找断点」升级成「会抢修 + 懂仪表」，学光纤与 5G，争取片区。
突出持证与抢修经历，写清管过哪些片区。运营商看重稳和冲。
选人别只看体力，要看有没有安全脑子。能独当一面的骨干值得给补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 光纤与 5G 拉动建设。
诊断数字化普及。
能抢修的更抢手。

body: 通信线路安装维修工安装、维护与抢修通信线缆及杆路设施，运用测试仪表定位故障并恢复连通，保障电话、宽带与移动网络的稳定。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 诊断系统能定位断点，但爬杆熔接、现场判断与应急抢修，还是线路工定。
